newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dongbu Steel places bonds with warrants.
newsitem.headline: Dongbu Steel places bonds with warrants.

text.p: South Korea's Dongbu Steel Co privately placed 30 billion won worth of bonds with warrants to raise operating funds, a company statement said on Thursday.
Hanwha Energy Plaza Co underwrote the bonds, which were issued on Wednesday, it said.
The bonds carry a coupon of 10 percent per annum and will mature on March 26, 2000.
The bonds can be converted into Dongbu's common shares between March 26, 1998 and March 25, 2000 at 11,790 won per share, the statement said.
Dongbu Steel shares closed Thursday's trading at 13,600 won, up 300 won on the day.
